tab.title: Cloud sync
tab.description: Keep your chiefs in a private GitHub repository and share them between your devices.
tab.descriptionGoogle: Keep your chiefs in your Google Drive and share them between your devices.

unavailable: Sync is not available in this build.
privacy: Your data goes to a private repository in your own GitHub account. Gamerdex has no server that stores it, and the app can only reach the one repository you choose.

signedOut.title: Sign in
signedOut.body: Sign in with GitHub, then choose the repository that holds your data.
signedOut.choose: Choose where to keep your data. It stays in your own account, and Gamerdex has no server that stores it.
signedOut.githubHint: A private repository named {name} in your GitHub account.
signedOut.googleHint: A folder named {name} in your Google Drive. Gamerdex can only see the files that it creates.

repository.title: Set up your data repository
repository.body: Your data is kept in a private repository named {name} in your GitHub account. Gamerdex Sync can only reach that one repository.
repository.checkFailed: Your repositories could not be loaded. Check your connection and check again.
repository.public: The repository {fullName} is public. Make it private in its GitHub settings, then check again. A public repository cannot be used, because anyone could read your data.

steps.create: Create a private repository named {name}. Tick Add a README file.
steps.install: Give Gamerdex Sync access to that repository only. Choose Only select repositories, then pick {name}.
steps.recheck: Come back here and check again.

connected.title: Connected
connected.signedOut: Signed out. The data on this device stays as it is.

error.notFound: The repository was not found. Choose it again.

error.data: The synced data is not valid, so nothing was changed.

error.reauth: Your sign in ended. Sign in again to keep syncing.

error.notFoundGoogle: A file or folder in Google Drive was not found. Sync again.
error.forbiddenGoogle: Google refused access to Drive. Sign in again and allow access to the files that Gamerdex creates.

choice.title: This device and the cloud both have data
choice.body: This is the first sync from this device. Pick what to do. Nothing is deleted from the cloud until you choose.
choice.mergeHint: Keep everything from both. The higher level wins.
choice.keepLocalHint: Replace the cloud data with the data on this device.
choice.keepCloudHint: Replace the data on this device with the cloud data.

conflicts.title: Changes that could not be merged
conflicts.body: Two devices changed the same value. The cloud value was kept. Pick this device's value to use it instead.
conflicts.deletedEdited: One device removed this and another changed it. The changed version was kept.

callback.title: Signing in
callback.state: The sign in could not be checked. Start again from Settings.
callback.missing: GitHub sent no sign in code. Start again from Settings.
callback.failed: The sign in could not be finished. Try again later.

github.name: GitHub
github.tile: A private repository that you own, named {name}.

google.name: Google Drive
google.tile: A visible Gamerdex folder in your Drive. Gamerdex sees only the files that it creates.

connect.title: Sync across devices
connect.intro: Keep your chiefs the same on your computer and your phone. Sync is optional and free. Pick where the copy lives.
connect.another: You can pick another provider before you sign in.
connect.firstSync: Choose what to keep on the first sync if both sides already have data. Nothing is replaced before you decide.

google.step1: Sign in with Google in this window.
google.step2: Allow access to the files that Gamerdex creates. The app cannot see your other files.

github.step1: Create an empty private repository named {name}. Tick Add a README file.
github.step2: Sign in with GitHub, then give Gamerdex Sync access to that repository only.

how.title: How sync works
how.one: Your chiefs are saved as one file in your own storage, plus a small file for the list of devices.
how.two: Gamerdex has no server that stores your data. Your browser talks to your storage directly.
how.three: Levels merge per entry and take the higher level. Names, notes and settings use the newer change.
how.four: Each device keeps its own open chief. Sync never switches it.
how.five: Disconnect at any time. Your chiefs stay on every device.

settings.title: Sync settings
settings.autoHint: Syncs when the tracker opens and a few seconds after each change.
settings.focus: Check for changes when I return to the tab
settings.focusHint: Pulls newer cloud data when you switch back to the tracker.

lives.title: Where your data lives
lives.note: The data file uses the same format as the backup file. The meta file holds the list of devices and no game data. Your sign in is never in either file.
lives.googleNote: The Gamerdex folder is visible in your Drive. Gamerdex can open only the files that it created.
lives.githubNote: Keep the repository private. Anyone who can open it can read your data.

device.title: This device
device.name: Device name
device.nameHint: The sync files show this name for this device. Renaming it updates the meta file on the next sync.
device.loginHint: The open chief is a choice on each device, and sync never changes it. Your sign in stays on this device. It is never in the saved data, the backup file or the sync files.

disconnect.title: Disconnect
disconnect.body: Stops syncing on this browser. Your chiefs stay on this device and in the cloud. Other devices keep syncing.
disconnect.googleHint: To delete the cloud copy yourself, disconnect, then delete the Gamerdex folder in your Google Drive.
disconnect.githubHint: To delete the cloud copy yourself, disconnect, then delete the Gamerdex folder in your repository.
